seed_ledger.name: Union Electric Co: gas supply to its plants in development
seed_ledger.reason: NO_DC_TIE: Ameren 2023 IRP power stations 1, 2 and 3 are placeholder resource-plan units with no site filings, no pipeline and no data center reason of their own. NO_DC_TIE: Castle Bluff Energy Center (848 MW, Oakville) was approved as a reliability and backup plant; no source names a data center reason or a new gas line. NOT_FOUND: Sioux replacement (West Alton Energy Center, 2,100 MW combined-cycle, 2031, filed July 2026) is next to Sioux; Ameren has signed large-load agreements, mostly data centers, but no source found names a gas supply project or sponsor, and the Marcellus Drilling News piece on gas supply is paywalled. Watch the Missouri case. Big Hollow (not a seed plant) was already staged by earlier runs. Searches run: 6. Sources: Spectrum News West Alton story (plant details, no pipeline); Power Engineering on Castle Bluff (reliability); St. Louis Public Radio and KCUR on Big Hollow (data centers, separate plant); Ameren investor release (no gas supply detail); Marcellus Drilling News (paywalled).

evidence.note: West Alton 2,100 MW combined-cycle plant next to Sioux, start 2031; no gas supply project named
Castle Bluff approved as a reliability and backup plant, no data center reason, gas supply not described

seed_ledger.name: WEC Energy Group Inc: gas supply to its plants in development
seed_ledger.reason: EXISTING_ROW: Elm Road (1,403 MW coal conversion to gas) depends on the We Energies Rochester Lateral, already staged by an earlier run and now roster row P8329; the Wisconsin PSC Rochester Lateral page confirms the lateral serves the Oak Creek and Elm Road campus. I found no filing tying the Elm Road conversion itself to data centers (the Oak Creek new gas plant is the one tied to data center load), so P8329 tag needs the earlier run's tie ref. NOT_FOUND: Weston (595 MW, Rothschild) is a Unit 4 coal conversion; no source names a gas line or a data center reason. Searches run: 5. Sources: Wisconsin PSC Rochester Lateral case page (lateral to Oak Creek and Elm Road); WPR and Data Center Dynamics on Oak Creek (data center link is to the new plant); WXPR and Sierra Club on Weston (no pipeline, no data center).

evidence.note: Rochester Lateral serves Oak Creek and Elm Road campus
